school Classroom Logic

This scientific comedic formula was originally discovered in the Bikini Bottom episode "New Student Starfish" (2002).

Why is this funny?

The Original: In SpongeBob SquarePants, Patrick Star nervously introduces himself as "24". SpongeBob later whispers, "You know what's funnier than 24? 25!"

The Evolution: The internet took this logic and applied it to other "funny" numbers like 420. If 420 is the "weed number", then 421 must be logically superior (and thus funnier) simply by being one higher.

"The absurdity lies in the arbitrary increment. It deconstructs the significance of the cultural meme number."
